**Finding submitted: deviation at § 13 (p0047).**

- **What we found:** § 13 is the document's only solicitation restraint (no other "solicit", "induce", "recruit" or "no-hire" language exists anywhere, including sec-1 and sec-6). It binds Clear Capital mutually, so it is in scope for us.
- **Already at fallback:** mutual ("Neither party shall"), scope limited to personnel "who have had direct involvement with the Services", and solicitation-only (no no-hire).
- **Fails fallback on two material terms:** the period runs for the entire term plus one year after termination (can far exceed 12 months from a person's involvement ending), and there is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out — the "consent not unreasonably withheld" softener is not a substitute.
- **Cure (fallback, validated ok:true):** re-anchor to "one (1) year after the end of such personnel's involvement with the Services", and add a single short carve-out sentence for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. All other wording preserved verbatim.
